Features

Everything Model Railroad Record Keeper does for your layout, on iPad and Mac.

Download on the App Store
Click See it to open that screen with a picture and the details.

Operating Sessions

Jobs list

Every switching, touring and delivery job in one filtered, sortable list.

Job builder

Steps, start and end tracks, the locomotive, and WiFi or throttle control.

Live operating board

Jobs move themselves from Unavailable to Available, Running and Finished.

Track locks

A job holding a track keeps conflicting jobs waiting until it clears.

Job rules

Available-when conditions and finish actions chain the session together.

Engineer assignments

Assign jobs from tonight's crew and print a run summary per engineer.

Job cards and schedule

Print the master job list, job cards and a full schedule.

Locomotives

Roster with photos

Road number, railroad, model and DCC details at a glance.

Decoder details

Decoder, address, sound card, stay-alive and install notes.

F1–F28 labels

Label every function key, or auto-fill from the sound card.

CV settings

Keep the CVs you changed, ready for the next decoder reset.

Function Key Matrix

One printout of every engine's function keys.

Rolling Stock

Car roster

Every freight and passenger car with photo, marks and type.

Full car record

Specs, couplers, NMRA weight, value and where you bought it.

Runner packs

One record can stand in for a set, so fleet counts stay true.

Custom column views

Save your own column layouts and print exactly what's on screen.

Car Cards & Waybills

Car card designer

Four card sizes, your choice of fields, color bands by car type.

Card List

Queue cars, set copies, and see what's already been printed.

Fold-up waybill pocket

Each card can print with a pocket that folds up and tapes shut.

Waybills, 1 to 4 cycles

For any car of a type or one specific car.

Fold-over slips

Cut, fold and turn end-for-end. No duplex printer needed.

Make Waybills from Traffic

Pairs shippers with receivers and drafts the waybills.

Locations & Traffic

Locations list

Towns, yards and industries with track counts and siding totals.

Location detail

Tracks, buildings, devices, vehicles and figures for each place.

Industry traffic

What each industry ships and receives, by commodity and car type.

Turnouts

Accessory decoder, address and port behind every switch.

Location labels

Large-type labels with the location's tracks, ready to stick on.

Inventory

Collection list

Structures, details and parts, three category levels deep.

Item detail

Purchase history, value, photo, for-sale price and storage spot.

Pivot table

Total the collection by category, maker, location or year.

Reorder alerts

Items at or below their reorder level stand out in the list.

Reference & To-Dos

Reference library

Manuals, decoder guides and wiring diagrams in one list.

Saved links and PDFs

Up to five links and an attached PDF for each piece of gear.

Built-in search browser

Find a manual on the web and save the link without leaving the app.

To-do list

Repairs, upgrades and someday ideas, tagged and prioritized.

Blog in the app

News, tips and how-tos, read right inside the app.

Your Railroad & Data

More than one layout

Home road and club layout, kept separate and one tap apart.

Backup and restore

A full dated backup you hold, with Undo Last Restore.

JMRI import, Excel export

Bring rosters in from JMRI; send lists out to Excel.

Setup walkthrough

Numbered steps from an empty app to your first session.

iPad and Mac

One purchase covers both. No account, works fully offline.

Help & Support

Extensive help

A ? help page on every screen, plus a searchable Help index.

Email support

Send a request from any screen, with screenshots and a support number.

Screen & report index

A printable list of every screen and report in the app.
